GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 095 (8 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 406)
APO 500
8 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Funds and Operations of Leybold K. K.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 095 (24 Oct 45) ESS/FI, Subject, "Funds and Operations of Leybold K.K.” C.L.O. No. 677(5.3), dated 21 Nov. 1945, Subject, "Application for Release of Funds by Leybold K.K."; and C.L.O. No. 751 (5.3), dated 28 Nov. 1945, Subject, "Application for Release of Funds by Leybold K.K."
2. This Headquarters has delegated to proper supervisors all matters pertaining to operations of, and release of funds to Leybold K.K., and applications for such releases should be presented directly to such supervisors by Leybold K.K.
3. Attention is directed to the fact that funds will be released to Leybold K.K. only for actual operating expenses incurred or monies used in work performed for the occupation forces.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
